name: Runway
meaning: Long straight paved strip for takeoff/landing
operationalImplication: Direction determines landing/takeoff orientation. Check VS/TS for runway in use.

name: Taxiway
operationalImplication: Follow taxi routes. Clear of runway before switching to ground.

name: Apron/Ramp
operationalImplication: Watch for vehicles/pedestrians. Engine running zone restrictions apply.

name: VOR
meaning: VHF Omnidirectional Range - provides bearing to station
operationalImplication: Use for navigation. QDM = heading to steer TO station.

name: VOR/DME
meaning: VOR combined with Distance Measuring Equipment
operationalImplication: Provides bearing AND distance to station. Use for navigation and holding.

name: NDB
meaning: Non-Directional Beacon - radio beacon for ADF
operationalImplication: Use with ADF for homing. Subject to static/interference.

name: ILS - Localizer
operationalImplication: Flown at MDA/DH. Full scale deflection = outside track.

name: ILS - Glide Slope
operationalImplication: Follow GS. At DH/MDA - go missed if not in sight.

name: Marker Beacon - OM/MM/IM
meaning: Radio markers indicating position on ILS approach
operationalImplication: OM = 4-7nm out, MM = ~3500ft, IM = at threshold.

name: PAPI
meaning: Precision Approach Path Indicator - 4-light glide path
operationalImplication: White = too high, Red = too low. 3 white 1 red = on glide.

name: VASI
meaning: Visual Approach Slope Indicator - 2 or 3-light system
operationalImplication: White = above, Red = below. On glide when both same color.

name: Control Zone - CTR
meaning: Controlled airspace from surface to specified altitude
operationalImplication: Requires clearance. Class D - two-way comm required.

name: TMA - Terminal Control Area
meaning: Control area around major aerodromes, often layered
operationalImplication: Usually Class C - need transponder and clearance.

name: Airway - AWY
operationalImplication: Controlled airspace. FL entry/exit. Requires flight plan.

name: Reporting Point
operationalImplication: Make position report when passing. Use as GPS waypoint.

name: VRP - Visual Reporting Point
meaning: Ground reference point for VFR position reporting
operationalImplication: Use for navigation and position reports. Prominent landmark.

name: ATZ - Aerodrome Traffic Zone
meaning: Airspace around aerodrome for circuit traffic
operationalImplication: Join circuit at published altitude. Report when entering.

name: RMZ - Radio Mandatory Zone
operationalImplication: Establish comm before entering. Listen and squawk.

name: TMZ - Transponder Mandatory Zone
operationalImplication: Squawk appropriate code. Transponder Mode C required.

name: Prohibited Area
operationalImplication: Do NOT enter. Military/government/security restrictions.

name: Restricted Area
operationalImplication: May enter if clearance obtained. Hazard may be active.

name: Danger Area
operationalImplication: Exercise caution. May contain military activity/obstacles.

name: Military Operating Area - MOA
operationalImplication: Civilian flights allowed but caution. Check NOTAM for active times.

name: Temporary Restricted Area
meaning: Restricted area active only during specified times
operationalImplication: Check activation times in AIP/supplements. May be inactive.

name: Gliding Area
operationalImplication: Watch for gliders without transponder. Thermal activity.

name: Obstacle - Wind Turbine
meaning: Wind turbine - tall obstacle with lighting
operationalImplication: Check obstacle clearance. May affect circuit/approach.

name: Obstacle - Tower/Pylon
operationalImplication: Check height and clearance. May have guy wires.

name: High Voltage Line
operationalImplication: Very difficult to see. Maintain safe altitude. Avoid low level.

name: Aerodrome - Civil
operationalImplication: Check AIP for services, frequencies, runway data.

name: Aerodrome - Military
operationalImplication: Usually restricted. May share with civilian ops. Check procedures.

name: Heliport
operationalImplication: Different circuits/procedures. Check approach paths.

name: Aerodrome with FATO
meaning: Heliport with Final Approach and Takeoff Area
operationalImplication: Designated heliport approach areas. PAPI/lighting available.

name: Water Aerodrome
operationalImplication: Check water area restrictions. Tides/conditions affect operations.

name: Closed Runway
operationalImplication: Do not use. May have equipment/workers on runway.

name: Runway Threshold - Displaced
meaning: Runway threshold displaced from physical beginning
operationalImplication: Reduced landing distance available. Check LDA.

name: Touchdown Zone
meaning: First portion of runway for touchdown
operationalImplication: Aim for this zone. Marked by painted touchdown markers.

name: Runway Edge Lights
meaning: Runway edge lighting - white (or yellow for calibrated)
operationalImplication: White = edge. Yellow = displaced threshold. Green = threshold.

name: Threshold Lights
operationalImplication: Indicates runway start for landing. Green = go.

name: Runway End Lights
operationalImplication: Do not pass beyond. End of usable runway.

name: REDL - Runway Edge Light
operationalImplication: Check AD for operating hours and intensity settings.

name: TDZL - Touchdown Zone Lights
operationalImplication: Helps with depth perception in low vis. Part of RCL system.

name: RCL - Runway Center Line Lights
operationalImplication: White = safe. Red/white = last 3000ft. Red = last 1000ft.

name: WDI - Wind Direction Indicator
operationalImplication: Check direction and intensity. Positioned at takeoff end if possible.

name: PAPIs - PAPI System
operationalImplication: L = left, R = right side. Standard 3° glide path.

name: T-VASIS
operationalImplication: On glide = light bar centered. Above/below = asymmetric pattern.

name: Precision Approach - CAT I/II/III
operationalImplication: CAT I = 200ft DH/550m RVR. CAT II = 100ft/300m. CAT III = below 100ft/0m.

name: MIL SIG
operationalImplication: Ground-to-air signals. Check meaning for joint operations.

name: VFR Route
operationalImplication: Follow route for easy navigation. Check altitudes per direction.

name: VRP with Frequency
meaning: Visual Reporting Point with published frequency
operationalImplication: Can request traffic info from AFIS on frequency.

name: FIR Boundary
operationalImplication: Crossing into new FIR = different ATS provider. Check frequencies.
